\section{Binding scientific requirements}
\label{sec:requirements}

The key words \emph{shall}, \emph{shall not}, \emph{required}, and
\emph{unavailable} are normative.  These requirements define scientific
conformance; they do not assert that any implementation satisfies them.

\newcommand{\JincReq}[2]{%
  \par\medskip\noindent\phantomsection
  \hypertarget{SCI-JINC-REQ-#1}{}%
  \textbf{\texttt{SCI-JINC-REQ-#1}.} #2\par}

\JincReq{001}{SCI-JINC shall define a signed spatial-kernel estimator for one
observation and stable array.  It shall consume exact PTC and AST parents
directly, consume no SCI-MAP product, and inherit no ordinary SCI-MAP
normalization, support, exposure, validity, response, covariance, product, or
coaddition rule by analogy.}

\JincReq{002}{Every candidate contribution shall bind one exact occurrence and
the AST continuous coordinate associated with the same processed sample
realization in the exact target JINC WCS.  Row order, detector order, nearest
time, tolerance, shape, cardinality, or numerical coordinate equality shall
not establish that association.}

\JincReq{003}{The transformed signal $z_i$ shall retain its exact PTC quantity,
unit, availability, application generation, retention state, immutable
parents, and producer causes.  SCI-JINC shall spatially transform that quantity
without creating calibration, conditioning, astrometry, empirical noise, or
source interpretation.}

\JincReq{004}{Every $\omega_i$ shall come from one exact family/version in the
single PTC-owned positive analysis/gridding coefficient registry.  The family
shall explicitly permit \texttt{SCI-JINC}, and its requested, effective,
observation-resolved, and realized identities, payload, QC, normalization,
support, provenance, covariance meaning, uncertainty, and prohibited meanings
shall remain bound.}

\JincReq{005}{A numerical route shall fail closed when coefficient selection is
missing without an authorized versioned mode default, the family is
unregistered, JINC permission is absent, or the payload/QC/identity is absent,
unavailable, incompatible, duplicate, or ambiguous.  SCI-JINC shall not infer
unity, another family, ordinary MAP permission, \texttt{sens}, loading,
scatter, inverse variance, precision, or significance.}

\JincReq{006}{After the producer-owned coefficient decision, SCI-JINC shall
admit only a finite strictly positive $\omega_i$.  Zero, negative, non-finite,
or unrepresentable upstream coefficient values shall not be deposited and
shall retain the exact profile-defined disposition and cause.}

\JincReq{007}{Every numerical kernel route shall bind one exact scientifically
authorized array-associated parameter-set identity containing finite positive
$s_a$, $a_a$, $b_a$, $c_a$, $(r_{\max})_a$, finite positive pixel size, and
effective integer \texttt{subpixel\_n}$\ge1$.  Missing authority shall make
the affected route unavailable without fallback.}

\JincReq{008}{The peak-normalized analytic primitive shall be
$\mathcal{J}(x)=2J_1(x)/x$ for $x\ne0$ with the removable limit
$\mathcal{J}(0)=1$, as in Equation~\eqref{eq:peak-jinc}.}

\JincReq{009}{The analytic coefficient shall follow
Equation~\eqref{eq:analytic-kernel}, including its fixed parameter ordering and
$r'_a=r/s_a$.  It shall have peak one, preserve
analytic zeros, and preserve every finite positive and negative lobe of the
complete product.}

\JincReq{010}{The sample center shall be resolved by a single-valued rounding
rule, its two-axis residual phase shall be quantized, and one point-evaluated
kernel matrix shall be selected.  This operator shall not be represented as or
replaced by pixel-area integration.}

\JincReq{011}{Tie handling, phase intervals, bin edges, representatives,
cache-index rounding, analytic-function evaluation, and accumulation order may
be engineering choices only when they are single-valued, preserve the accepted
point-phase operator, and meet the numerical-adequacy requirement.}

\JincReq{012}{$(r_{\max})_a$ shall place the first zero of the second JINC
factor and fix the fully populated square-cache half-width.  Every resolved
square pixel, including a corner with radius greater than $(r_{\max})_a$, shall
be evaluated; no circular cutoff or radial membership predicate shall be
applied.}

\JincReq{013}{Before any footprint evaluation, the resolved rounded cache
center shall lie within the finite destination pixel domain.  An outside center
shall set $I_{ip}=0$ for every pixel, even when its square would overlap the
map; footprint-overlap admission is prohibited.}

\JincReq{014}{For an admitted in-map center, square pixels outside the finite
map shall be absent.  The route shall not wrap, reflect, complete the footprint,
substitute an interior normalizer, renormalize the edge, or require
JINC-then-crop equivalence.}

\JincReq{015}{Every evaluated $\kappa_{ip}$ shall be finite.  A finite negative
coefficient is normal and shall retain its sign; an analytic zero is a
contract-defined zero contribution distinct from outside support; a non-finite
coefficient shall fail the affected required bundle before deposition rather
than be clipped, skipped, or zero-filled.}

\JincReq{016}{All coupled accumulator terms for one contribution shall use the
same exact occurrence, AST association, sample-admission decision,
rounded-center decision, sample-pixel membership, phase, and $\kappa_{ip}$
identity.}

\JincReq{017}{The required accumulators shall be distinct and shall obey
Equations~\eqref{eq:numerator}--\eqref{eq:quadratic}.  Negative lobes shall keep
their sign in $N_p$ and $C_p$ and enter $Q_p$ quadratically.}

\JincReq{018}{The published signal estimate shall be $m_p=N_p/C_p$ and the
fixed-state normalized operator shall be Equation~\eqref{eq:operator}.  No
$Q_p$ denominator or other local measurement model shall be substituted.}

\JincReq{019}{Local formal support shall require finite admitted inputs,
finite $N_p$, $C_p$, and $Q_p$, $Q_p>0$, $C_p\ne0$, and numerically adequate
resolved cancellation.  A rejected pixel shall carry local invalid support in
the \texttt{jinc\_map} role and shall not receive a finite substitute.}

\JincReq{020}{A finite negative $C_p$ shall be admissible.  Exact $C_p=0$ shall
be locally invalid and unavailable, never interpreted as zero sky, infinity,
or a valid non-finite map value.}

\JincReq{021}{SCI-JINC shall retain the dimensionless conditioning statistic
$\rho_p$ of Equation~\eqref{eq:cancellation-ratio}.  A finite nonzero result
shall be supported only when total numerical error is demonstrably negligible
relative to the approximately $10^{-3}$ instrument-fidelity scale; otherwise
near cancellation shall be locally invalid.}

\JincReq{022}{No universal $\rho_p$ cutoff, unit-bearing $C_p$ or $Q_p$ floor,
contributor-count/machine-epsilon formula, prescribed summation algorithm,
fixed reduction order, bitwise reproducibility, or stronger precision shall be
treated as scientific authority.}

\JincReq{023}{Total numerical error from finite arithmetic, accumulation and
reduction order, analytic-function evaluation, phase quantization, and
cache/index realization shall remain negligible relative to the approximately
$10^{-3}$ instrument-fidelity scale while preserving exact membership and the
point-phase square operator.}

\JincReq{024}{The unit relations in Table~\ref{tab:notation} and the two
allowed $\omega_i$ unit classes shall be preserved.  Common positive scaling of
all $\omega_i$ shall leave $m_p$, $\rho_p$, and $A_{pi}$ invariant; signal-unit
rescaling shall transform the estimator consistently.}

\JincReq{025}{Equations~\eqref{eq:conditional-variance}--
\eqref{eq:general-covariance} may receive a formal statistical interpretation
only when the exact PTC family and covariance assumptions establish it.
Inverse-square units or historical labels alone shall not establish variance,
precision, covariance, or significance.}

\JincReq{026}{The required time-support product shall be exactly
Equation~\eqref{eq:kappa-time}.  It shall square $\kappa_{ip}$, not $\omega_i$
or $w_{ip}$, and shall have unit seconds.}

\JincReq{027}{\texttt{jinc\_coefficient\_squared\_time} shall be described only
as method-specific coefficient-squared temporal accounting.  It shall not be
interpreted as physical acquired exposure, valid-original exposure, complete
temporal support, hits, normalized influence, white-noise-equivalent time,
precision, validity, confidence, or significance.}

\JincReq{028}{Every produced base-v0.1 bundle shall contain exactly five
required roles: \path{jinc_signal_numerator},
\path{jinc_signed_normalization}, \path{jinc_quadratic_accumulator}, derived
\path{jinc_map} with local support/validity, and
\path{jinc_coefficient_squared_time}.}

\JincReq{029}{Failure to form or publish any required whole-product role shall
suppress the affected bundle atomically.  Pixel-local zero, insufficient,
cancelled, or otherwise invalid support shall remain ordinary bundle content
and shall not suppress an otherwise complete role or create a role-availability
object.}

\JincReq{030}{One observation may produce zero through three independent
bundles, with at most one for each stable array admitted and requested under
the exact JINC realization.  A missing, unavailable, or unrequested array shall
create no placeholder or empty-array product and shall not invalidate another
array's bundle.}

\JincReq{031}{Each bundle shall be independently identified by observation,
stable array, exact JINC plan and realization, target WCS, product role, and
lifecycle generation.  Contributions with different array or destination
identities shall never merge.}

\JincReq{032}{The complete destination identity shall be resolved before
allocation, numerical mutation, output side effects, or parallel execution.
Ambiguous, duplicate, or aliased destination ownership shall fail the affected
bundle without selecting a winner or publishing a partial result.}

\JincReq{033}{Same-observation samples or chunks may accumulate incrementally
only when observation, stable array, JINC plan and realization, target WCS,
admission/parameter/coefficient state, destination, and lifecycle generation
are identical.  Chunk, worker, process, container, filename, and vector
position shall not create product identity.}

\JincReq{034}{Base v0.1 shall authorize no cross-observation combination.
Any future JINC coadd shall require a separately authorized boundary over
complete observation bundles and shall not infer accumulator addition,
normalized-map combination, or ordinary SCI-MAP coaddition.}

\JincReq{035}{The immutable
\texttt{SCI-JINC:jinc\_map\_contribution@1} evaluation shall remain distinct
from PTC signal availability, PTC retention, coefficient availability/QC, AST
coordinate validity and association, finite signal, finite positive
$\omega_i$, parameter availability, rounded-center admission, pixel support,
finite $\kappa_{ip}$, cancellation, and final bundle validity.}

\JincReq{036}{Only a fact named by an exact restriction shall control JINC
admission.  Producer causes and transitive influence shall be preserved, but a
generic flag or cause shall have no universal veto.  Outside support, an
analytic zero, or an outside rounded center shall be ordinary no-contribution;
a finite negative lobe shall not create a cause.}

\JincReq{037}{ALIGN/AST, RTC, CAL, PTC, and VAL shall retain the meanings they
own.  SCI-JINC shall own only its admission use, local geometry, point phase,
square support, signed coefficient, normalization, conditioning, fixed
accumulators, local support, grouping, destination, and atomic bundle
publication.}

\JincReq{038}{Base v0.1 shall publish no response, variance, formal-weight,
covariance, empirical-noise, or significance product.  The conditional
mathematics in Section~\ref{sec:conditional-math} shall remain preserved for a
future concrete scientific use without being promoted to a present role.}

\JincReq{039}{Base v0.1 shall publish no physical-exposure product.  Any
future exposure role shall require separate authority for exact original-
occurrence lineage and semantics and shall not reinterpret
$T_p^{(\kappa^2)}$.}

\JincReq{040}{Base v0.1 shall create no standalone support or availability
role, generic optional or conditionally required role mechanism, detailed operational-cause
archive, diagnostic role, generalized provenance product, or per-pixel or
per contribution provenance system.}

\JincReq{041}{No TolTEC numerical parameter realization, recommendation,
optimum, hidden default, or fallback is authorized by v0.1.  In particular, an
inherited 45~m denominator, inherited shape values, or mode-dependent
$r_{\max}$ values shall not be treated as scientific authority.}

\JincReq{042}{A future conformance assessment shall exercise every prediction
in Section~\ref{sec:predictions}, disclose its numerical acceptance policy, and
separate algebraic correctness from implementation conformity,
representation/response fidelity, numerical and observational validation,
achieved performance, readiness, and production authorization.  This Stage B
draft establishes none of those later claims.}
